post.summary: Send one sealed message through a device link
post.description: Body: {"id": 32 lowercase hex link ID shown in a QR code, "slot": "request" or "response", "data": sealed text up to 16384 bytes}. Each slot is written once. Links expire ten minutes after their first message. Messages are sealed between the two devices; the node relays them without reading them.
Body: {"id", "slot"}. Returns {"data"} once the other device has written the slot.

404.description: Waiting for the other device, or the link expired

post.description: Body: {"id"}. Either device closes the link once it is connected or cancelled.
